title: Welcome to October at The Anchor
preheader: Three nights out this month, all with a Halloween lean, and the clocks go back on the 25th.

data.heading: Welcome to October
body: Three nights out this month, and all of them lean into Halloween, finishing with the party itself on Saturday the 31st.

The clocks go back on Sunday 25 October, so it will be dark by teatime. We are open seven days a week, from midday Tuesday to Sunday and from 4pm on Mondays. The kitchen times for each day are further down this email.

events.name: A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night
events.detail: 7pm start, £3 cash on arrival, teams of up to six. Spooky touches, but no horror knowledge needed.

image.alt: A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

events.name: Screams & Soundtracks Music Bingo
events.detail: 7pm start, £5 cash on arrival. Nikki Manfadge hosts two rounds of classic horror soundtracks.

image.alt: Screams and Soundtracks classic horror music bingo at The Anchor

events.name: House of Horrors Halloween Party
events.detail: 8pm to midnight, free entry, fancy dress encouraged. Come early if you want a good spot.

image.alt: Enter If You Dare, the House of Horrors Halloween party at The Anchor

events.cta_label: Let us know you are coming →

data.heading: When we are open
data.footnote: Last orders are 30 minutes before the kitchen closes and 15 minutes before the bar does. The clocks go back on Sunday 25 October, but our hours do not change.

data.heading: One date is different

rows.note: Full menu 12pm to 6pm, kitchen shut 6pm to 9pm, then pizza only

data.footnote: Halloween is the only date in October that differs from the week above. Pizza from 9pm is available to eat in or to take away.

image.alt: A Sunday roast at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

cards.heading: Sunday roast
cards.body: 1pm to 6pm every Sunday, last seating 5.30pm. Nothing to pre-order and no Saturday cutoff.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner laid out at The Anchor

cards.heading: Christmas is booking
cards.body: Sittings run 10 November to 20 December, from four guests up, with a £10 per person deposit.

data.heading: Coming in November
body: Sparks & Sparklers Quiz Night on Wednesday 4 November, then Sequins & Showstoppers Music Bingo on Friday 13 November and a Snowball Showdown Cash Bingo on Wednesday 18 November. We will write to you about each one nearer the time.

data.body: Quiz team, bingo card or fancy dress, we would rather see you than not. Book a table or just turn up.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
